controls.alternate_class_donor_soft: frozen donor row for q=(baseline_argmax+1)%width, only if donor recorded soft argmax=q

decision_branches.condition: H1L1_ANCHOR preserves head and ordinary generation frame accuracy within 0.05 and improves alternate-one-hot scheduled-24 nontrivial_joint_success by at least 0.10
both arms have strong heads and positive scheduled joint follow-through and ordinary frame means differ by less than 0.05
both arms have strong heads but weak scheduled joint follow-through
same-class soft-shape changes parsed target values or lowers non-target preservation by at least 0.10; withhold canonical-class interpretation
H1L1 constant-source ablation is within 0.05 absolute of the H1L1 three-seed ordinary frame mean; withhold source-dependent interpretation and do not add a trained arm
unseen_pair frame exact mean is at most 0.02 and seen_pair/unseen_triple exceeds it by at least 0.10
frame exact improves without exact target text recovery; report frame recovery without surface-variant reconstruction claim
alternate one-hot has nontrivial joint success while donor-soft does not; continuous soft-distribution following remains unconfirmed
donor-soft has nontrivial joint success while alternate one-hot does not; shape sensitivity is shown without canonical-class control evidence
any preflight drift, budget breach, primary gate unreachability, raw-field omission, or protocol mismatch

donors.selection_rule: lexicographically first eligible train row ID for every authored class; exclude all confirmation probe IDs; freeze before training

fsm.candidate_uniqueness: exact target text maps to one GrammarCandidate
fsm.reachability_rule: any target mask true at or after consumed prefix and before target slot end
fsm.schedule_rule: history_p=[BOS_ID]+[BYTE_OFFSET+b for b in candidate.byte_values[:p]], p=0..len(byte_values)-1
